record.scope_reason: Sparse-autoencoder features improve interpretability of generic artificial-text detection. Physical pages 2–3 use the diverse-model COLING GenAI benchmark and RAID, with feature classifiers, domain/model comparisons and steering. No biomedical-primary detection task is established.

record.title: Low-Resource Grammatical Error Correction: Selective Data Augmentation with Round-Trip Machine Translation
record.scope_reason: SeLex-RT creates grammatical-error-correction data for Russian and Ukrainian language learners using round-trip translation. The complete abstracts concern spelling/lexical error correction rather than clinical language impairment.

record.title: Just Put a Human in the Loop? Investigating LLM-Assisted Annotation for Subjective Tasks
record.scope_reason: Boundary candidate included on actual public-health experimental primacy despite a general annotation-method title. Physical pages 3–4 explicitly designate 200 NYC health-resource/vaccine-decision interview excerpts as the main dataset, tested with a control, all three GPT assistance conditions and a Llama replication. Boston housing/safety/political conversations are only a partial Condition1 replication. Pages 6–9 report main NYC label-overlap/performance experiments; Table2 on page8 covers 20 health/vaccine labels, and discussion directly shows changes in inferred vaccine motivations and Health Education/Support. Retain the broader computational-social-science purpose and nonmedical replication; this does not measure clinical outcomes. Sent for independent central scope adjudication.

record.title: Research Community Perspectives on “Intelligence” and Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: The survey examines researchers’ concepts of intelligence and views of LLMs. Physical pages 3–4 detail field/career demographics, conceptual criteria and research goals. Neuroscience and psychology are respondent disciplines, not biomedical experiments or clinical intelligence assessment.

record.title: LEMONADE: A Large Multilingual Expert-Annotated Abstractive Event Dataset for the Real World
record.scope_reason: LEMONADE performs multilingual armed-conflict event extraction/entity linking from ACLED. The complete abstracts concern geopolitical conflict events, not biomedical entities or health-outcome surveillance.

record.title: Memorization vs. Reasoning: Updating LLMs with New Knowledge
record.scope_reason: KUP and memory-conditioned training update general world knowledge. Physical pages 3–4 synthesize changing facts for 1000 people/companies/landmarks/infrastructure/institutions/sports/technology/media/law/events entities, supplementing with news. No clinical or biomedical-primary knowledge updates.

record.title: CourtEval: A Courtroom-Based Multi-Agent Evaluation Framework
record.scope_reason: CourtEval applies courtroom-role multi-agent evaluation to SummEval and TopicalChat. These are generic summarization/dialogue meta-evaluation, not medical counselling or clinical judgment.

record.title: Multilingual Definition Modeling
record.scope_reason: Multilingual definition modeling uses monolingual dictionaries in Spanish, French, Portuguese and German. The complete abstracts concern monosemic word definitions and general multilingual-model evaluation, not medical terminology.

record.title: Human Bias in the Face of AI: Examining Human Judgment Against Text Labeled as AI Generated
record.scope_reason: The human preference experiment studies bias against AI-labeled writing. Physical pages 2–3 use Wikipedia rephrasing, CNN/DailyMail summarization and broad controversial-topic persuasion with MTurk raters. Human cognitive implications are not a clinical/mental-health task.

record.title: Redundancy, Isotropy, and Intrinsic Dimensionality of Prompt-based Text Embeddings
record.scope_reason: Embedding redundancy/isotropy is assessed across generic MTEB categories. Physical pages 2–3 specify Amazon/IMDB/toxicity classification, Reddit/StackExchange/arXiv clustering, MIRACL/Quora/HotpotQA/DBPedia/NQ/MSMARCO retrieval and STS/SICK. No biomedical-primary experiment.

record.title: Harnessing Whisper for Prosodic Stress Analysis
record.scope_reason: Stress here means linguistic prosodic prominence, not psychological stress. Physical pages 2–3 use 36 native-English college students explicitly reporting no vision, hearing, language, learning or neuropsychological issues, and minimal-pair phrasal/lexical/contrastive stress. Although the elicitation test has speech-clinical origins, the actual research is nonclinical prosody recognition and gender-linked acoustic variation.

record.title: Can You Share Your Story? Modeling Clients’ Metacognition and Openness for LLM Therapist Evaluation
record.scope_reason: Medical-primary psychological-counselling evaluation: physical pages 3,5,6,8 describe MindVoyager using expert CBT cognitive diagrams from Patient-psi-CM, dynamically masking/unmasking client beliefs according to openness and metacognition. Experiments compare LLM therapists with cognitive-diagram exposure and induced-similarity metrics, not actual patient benefit. Final PDF expressly disclaims advocating LLM counselling. It is simulator-based mental-health-system assessment, not validated treatment.

record.title: Dictionaries to the Rescue: Cross-Lingual Vocabulary Transfer for Low-Resource Languages Using Bilingual Dictionaries
record.scope_reason: Dictionary-based vocabulary transfer adapts language models to seven languages. Physical pages 4–5 evaluate WikiANN/ManNER NER and language-model perplexity on dictionaries, Wikipedia and Manwen Laodang. No medical dictionaries or biomedical-primary NER.

record.title: When Should Dense Retrievers Be Updated in Evolving Corpora? Detecting Out-of-Distribution Corpora Using GradNormIR
record.scope_reason: GradNormIR detects distribution shift for generic dense retrievers. Physical pages 5–6 show ten BEIR datasets spanning arguments, climate facts, DBPedia, finance, Quora, science and biomedical NFCorpus/TREC-COVID. Biomedical retrieval is a real parallel component, not the primary focus; BioASQ is explicitly excluded as inaccessible.

record.title: The Million Authors Corpus: A Cross-Lingual and Cross-Domain Wikipedia Dataset for Authorship Verification
record.scope_reason: Million Authors Corpus models Wikipedia edit authorship across languages and topics. The complete abstracts concern authorship verification and domain generalization, not biomedical writing or clinical identity assessment.

record.title: BridG MT: Enhancing LLMs’ Machine Translation Capabilities with Sentence Bridging and Gradual MT
record.scope_reason: BridG MT improves low-resource translation through sentence bridges. Physical page4 evaluates FLORES-200 and NTREX-128 across seven target languages; no medical-domain translation.

record.title: Text2World: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Symbolic World Model Generation
record.scope_reason: Text2World generates symbolic PDDL world models. Physical pages3–5 curate 103 planning domains from public repositories/competitions and analyze path planning, constraints and task allocation. It is general planning benchmark construction, not biomedical modeling.

record.title: Blinded by Context: Unveiling the Halo Effect of MLLM in AI Hiring
record.scope_reason: The halo-effect audit evaluates hypothetical job applications, extracurricular text and social-media images. The complete abstracts concern hiring model bias, not clinical mental-health, medical imaging or healthcare employment specifically.

record.title: CoT-UQ: Improving Response-wise Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs with Chain-of-Thought
record.scope_reason: CoT-UQ quantifies response uncertainty across logical and mathematical reasoning. The complete abstracts do not specify a biomedical-primary evaluation.

record.title: ADO: Automatic Data Optimization for Inputs in LLM Prompts
record.scope_reason: ADO optimizes generic input data. Physical pages6–7 evaluate nine parallel datasets: StrategyQA, job fraud, GSM8K, three Amazon recommendation sets, census income, heart disease and financial distress. Heart-disease prediction is one genuine benchmark among nine, not biomedical-primary research.

record.title: IntentionESC: An Intention-Centered Framework for Enhancing Emotional Support in Dialogue Systems
record.reason: IntentionESC specifically models emotional support using therapist intentions adapted from Helping Skills counseling theory, linking emotional states, intentions and support strategies. Main ESConv experiments evaluate support responses and empathic/helpfulness dimensions, so it is a dedicated mental-health-support candidate. ESConv1300 dialogues and human/GPT4 evaluations, including GPT4-simulated seekers, do not establish clinical efficacy. Whole-conversation agreement is low (reported kappa .12/.17/.26/.27); no patient-outcome claim. Formal Long/Short pending.

record.title: CSTRL: Context-Driven Sequential Transfer Learning for Abstractive Radiology Report Summarization
record.reason: CSTRL is dedicated radiology Findings-to-Impression summarization using gap-sentence pretraining, Fisher-guided sequential learning and distillation. Main experiments use MIMIC-CXR/OpenI report text, factuality/text metrics and fifty reports rated by three radiology researchers plus two clinical radiologists. This is actual clinical documentation research; benchmark and small expert evaluation do not establish deployment safety or patient benefit. Formal Long/Short pending.
